speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you tell me if you have experienced any recent head trauma, seizures, or neck stiffness? Also, have you noticed any sensitivity to light or changes in your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of taking haloperidol, I need to rule out Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. Do you currently experience any severe muscle rigidity or involuntary movements? Additionally, are you experiencing excessive sweating or fluctuations in your blood pressure?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for providing those specific details; the combination of fever, altered mentation, generalized rigidity, and autonomic instability strongly points to a specific diagnosis. I will now request a Creatine Kinase (CK) level and a complete blood count to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Creatine Kinase REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count
